papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.abstract: DPR uses separate encoders for questions and passages, so passage vectors can be indexed before search. The paper evaluates dense retrieval against a BM25 baseline on open-domain question answering datasets including Natural Questions.

papers.title: BEIR: A Heterogenous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
papers.abstract: BEIR evaluates how retrieval systems generalize across domains and tasks. The benchmark compares lexical, sparse, dense, late-interaction, and reranking methods on a collection of public retrieval datasets.
